beats.speakEn: In Chapter 8 you learnt that atoms can lose, gain or share electrons. Now we ask a new question: when substances change, does their total mass change?

beats.en: Activity 9.1: weigh water and salt in a beaker, then let the salt dissolve. The mass of the solution equals the mass of the water plus the salt, so in a physical change there is practically no change in mass.
beats.speakEn: Activity 9.1: weigh water and salt in a beaker, then let the salt dissolve. The mass of the solution equals the mass of the water plus the salt, so in a physical change there is practically no change in mass.
